theme: Fresh botanical green with organic, nature-inspired aesthetic

headings.usage: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for H1/H2. Never use Inter for headings.

body.usage: Clean, highly readable font for dashboard data and plant care text. Loose line height (leading-relaxed).

typography.instruction: Import Google fonts (@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:wght@400;600;700&family=Manrope:wght@400;500;600&display=swap');) in index.css. Ensure fonts are loaded before applying. Add font-family configurations to tailwind.config.js.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Tactile' style for cards: solid background (bg-white), 1px border (border-[#1E3F20]/10), and very soft, diffuse ambient shadow (shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(30,63,32,0.04)]). DO NOT use heavy generic shadows.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: For sticky headers or floating elements, use backdrop-blur-xl with bg-[#F7F9F5]/70. Must have a delicate 1px border at the bottom (border-[#1E3F20]/10).
visual_enhancers.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for primary actions. Primary buttons use Forest Green (bg-[#1E3F20] text-white hover:bg-[#132A15]). Use subtle scale down on click (active:scale-95).
visual_enhancers.textures: Consider a very subtle SVG noise overlay on the hero section to make it feel organic, not perfectly sterile.
visual_enhancers.borders: Generous border radius on imagery (rounded-2xl to rounded-3xl). Keep it natural.

components.hero: Bento-grid inspired split. Left side: organic, large typography with direct CTA. Right side: dynamic layered image or overlapping cards showing the app's capability.
components.image_upload: Massive hit area (p-12 to p-16). Dashed border (border-2 border-dashed border-[#1E3F20]/20). Center content: Lucide Leaf icon, primary text 'Drag & Drop leaf photo', secondary text 'or click to browse'. On drag over, transition border to solid Forest Green and add subtle bg tint.
components.diagnosis_result: Dense 'Bento' style dashboard card. Top: Large result (Disease Name) + confidence score. Middle: Severity meter (using a visual progress bar with Moss->Ochre->Terracotta). Bottom: Tabs or accordion for 'Treatment' and 'Prevention'.
components.detection_history: Masonry or strict CSS Grid of leaf thumbnails. Group by date. Use aspect-square for thumbnails. Overlay the disease name on hover using a glass pane.
components.disease_library: Grid of informational cards. Each card has an image, title, and a couple of tags (e.g., 'Fungal', 'High Severity').
components.navigation: Sticky top bar. Logo on left (use a leaf icon + brand name). Links centered. Google Auth / User Profile on right.

layouts.spacing_system: Generous Spacing: p-6, p-8, p-12. Containers must have internal padding. For sections, use py-20 or py-24 to let content breathe.
layouts.grid_strategy: Mobile-first. Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 with wide gaps (gap-8). For the dashboard specific views, tighten the gap (gap-4 or gap-6) and use high density.
layouts.alignment: Left-align mostly. Only center the hero text if it creates a strong, balanced poster-like aesthetic.

motion.hover_states: All cards should subtly lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow deepens. Icons in buttons can translate-x-1 on hover.
motion.page_transitions: Fade in on load. Stagger children in grids (e.g., history items or library cards fade and slide up sequentially).
motion.interactions: Use framer-motion for the upload drag state and the severity meter fill animation.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has a dark gradient overlay (e.g., bg-black/40). Text on Forest Green must be white. Text on Sage should be Forest Green.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='upload-area', data-testid='login-button', data-testid='history-card-0').

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize optical alignment and generous spacing (e.g., p-8, p-12).
Do NOT use standard Shadcn card styles (heavy shadows, generic borders). Strip them down to the 'Tactile' style defined in visual_enhancers.
Implement a bento-grid layout for the diagnosis result to present complex ML data (severity, confidence) in a digestible, dashboard-like format.
Do not center align paragraphs or lists. Keep text left-aligned.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, inputs, and clickable cards.
For the image upload zone, use dashed borders and ensure a massive hit area.
Avoid Inter for headings. Use Cormorant Garamond for all H1-H4.
Ensure dark text is used on light backgrounds for APCA contrast compliance.
Implement Google Auth layout standardly, matching the organic theme (custom button styling).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid 'AI slop'. Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur). Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy. DO NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). You MUST NOT center align the app container. Every interaction needs micro-animations. Use 2-3x more spacing. Never use placeholder text for missing images, use the provided ones.
